svg.title: The steps of a final result
svg.desc: A final result starts as a Draft when you press Start. You choose which exams count and how much each counts, then build the results. After you check them, you publish. Guardians then see the result and you can send the SMS and print the cards. Reopening needs extra approval and puts the result back to Built.
